note: AI removal, picked objects and landscape masks, bundled and run offline on the CPU. LaMa big-lama (Apache-2.0, advimman/lama; ONNX by smile-forge with its Fourier units as matrix products, weights unchanged) fills removals (lumen/remove.py). EfficientViT-SAM L0 (Apache-2.0, MIT Han Lab; official ONNX export) selects the object under a click. EfficientViT-Seg B2 ADE20K (Apache-2.0, MIT Han Lab) has no ONNX upstream: tools/convert_landscape.py exports it from efficientvit_seg_b2_ade20k.pt (huggingface.co/han-cai/efficientvit-seg revision cf3ccaf, sha256 fabfa716…b510) with the ADE20K classes summed into five landscape groups; the file is published on LUMEN RAW's own GitHub release. Pinned revisions; packages store the weights as float16 (tools/compact_models.py).

files.conversion: python tools/convert_landscape.py <efficientvit checkout> efficientvit_seg_b2_ade20k.pt landscape-seg.onnx (PyTorch 2.14.1 legacy exporter, opset 17; largest difference to PyTorch 4.3e-06)
